heading: Entry of articles for fairs
lead: Any article imported or brought into the United States— may, without payment of any duty or internal-revenue tax, be entered under bond under this section for the purpose of exhibition at a fair, or for use in constructing, installing, or maintaining foreign exhibits at a fair.

tree.text: which is in continuous customs custody, covered by a customs exhibition bond, or in a foreign trade zone, and
on which no duty or internal-revenue tax has been paid,
